newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris court to make Eurotunnel statement.
newsitem.headline: Paris court to make Eurotunnel statement.

text.p: The president of the Paris commercial court, Jean-Pierre Mattei, is expected to make a statement on Eurotunnel SA /Plc, probably today, a court official said on Tuesday.
"There will be a statement made by the president of the commercial court, probably today " the official told Reuters.
The official said the statement was being prepared but was not yet ready. She gave no further details.

Mattei appointed Robert Badinter and Lord Wakeham as mediators to help Eurotunnel negotiate a restructuring of its junior bank debt and interest totalling some 70 billion francs. Their mandate expired on Monday midnight and was not renewed.

Eurotunnel co-chairmen Alistair Morton and Patrick Ponsolle have been in intensive talks with six leading bank lenders to break a deadlock in the debt negotiations. The company froze interest payments in September last year.
